Sarit Belong - Mall Loyalty & Membership Platform

A major Nairobi shopping centre wanted one loyalty and membership programme spanning shoppers, tenants and the centre's
own operations — rewards, stored value, vouchers, parking, events and deliveries — instead of disconnected tools.
I built all four web portals on top of the team's modular Jakarta EE backend:
— programme configuration, promotions, segments, vouchers and reporting
— membership, e-purse, gift registry and public event pages
— a QR check-in app for gate staff
Every request from the Nuxt server is signed with an RSA key before it reaches the backend.
Role-based permissions down to individual operations and entities
Event parking via QR: pay the event rate now, or later through an SMS link
E-purse and vouchers funded through M-Pesa STK push
Embedded Superset reports for the centre's management
four Nuxt 4 apps with server-side request signing

Java 21, Jakarta EE 10 on WildFly, ~17 modules (account, e-purse, finance, M-Pesa, parking, promotion,
voucher, delivery, segment, report, scheduler…)
Keycloak with user federation and a custom theme
native Android app alongside the web portals
Live on the centre's production domains and under very active development.

Loyalty and membership platform for one of Nairobi's major shopping centres, covering customer accounts, an e-purse, vouchers, promotions, parking and delivery/pickup slot booking. Four Nuxt portals (admin, outlet, customer, security gate) sit on a modular Jakarta EE backend alongside native mobile apps, with M-Pesa payments, QR-based event parking and embedded Superset reporting.
Built the four Nuxt web portals (admin, outlet, customer, security gate) against the team’s Jakarta EE backend.

Loan management system taking borrowers from lead to closure for a microfinance lender, replacing spreadsheet and email workflows. Built on a double-entry ledger with end-of-day processing, maker/checker approvals, product rules and approval limits, and KCB bank disbursement that only activates a loan once the bank confirms the transfer — so it can never pay out twice.

Multi-tenant fundraising platform that lets churches and organisations run campaigns, register pledges, collect donations via M-Pesa STK push and reach supporters with SMS outreach. One deployment serves multiple brands, switching identity by domain, with per-organisation payment and SMS credentials, role-based access and a full audit log.
